# Parse old_songs.txt to extract song titles and artists
import re

content = old_songs_file['content']
old_songs = []
for line in content.split('\n'):
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Format: "- Title by Artist1, Artist2"
        song_part = line[2:]
        # Split on " by " to separate title and artists
        if ' by ' in song_part:
            title, artists_str = song_part.split(' by ', 1)
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
            old_songs.append({'title': title.strip(), 'artists': artists})

print(f"Parsed {len(old_songs)} old songs")

# Parse the songs to archive from the file content
import re

content = file_data['content']
songs_to_archive = []
for line in content.split('\n'):
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Remove the leading "- "
        song_line = line[2:]
        # Split on " by " (last occurrence)
        if ' by ' in song_line:
            title, artist = song_line.rsplit(' by ', 1)
            songs_to_archive.append((title.strip(), artist.strip()))
print(songs_to_archive)

# Let's fetch all playlists by paginating through all pages
all_playlists = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    playlists_page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not playlists_page:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(playlists_page)
    if len(playlists_page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print(f"Total playlists found: {len(all_playlists)}")
print("Playlist titles:", [p['title'] for p in all_playlists])

import re

old_songs = []
for line in file_data['content'].splitlines():
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    # Format: "- Title by Artist1, Artist2"
    m = re.match(r'^- (.+) by (.+)$', line)
    if m:
        title = m.group(1).strip()
        artists = [a.strip() for a in m.group(2).split(',')]
        old_songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists})

for song in songs_to_archive:
    title = song['title']
    artists = song['artists']
    # Search for the song by title
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=title, access_token=access_token, page_limit=20)
    # Find the result that matches the title and all artists
    found = None
    for result in results:
        if result['title'].lower() == title.lower():
            result_artists = [a['name'] for a in result['artists']]
            # Check if all expected artists are in the result artists
            if all(artist in result_artists for artist in artists):
                found = result
                break
    if found:
        song_id_map[title] = found['song_id']
        print(f"Found: {title} -> song_id {found['song_id']}")
    else:
        print(f"NOT FOUND: {title}")

# Let's parse the file content to get the list of songs to archive
import re
lines = file_content.strip().split('\n')
# Skip the header line
song_lines = [line.strip() for line in lines[1:] if line.strip()]
songs_to_archive = []
for line in song_lines:
    # Format: "- Title by Artist"
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
    # Split on " by " (case sensitive)
    if ' by ' in line:
        title, artist = line.split(' by ', 1)
        songs_to_archive.append({'title': title.strip(), 'artist': artist.strip()})
    else:
        # fallback
        songs_to_archive.append({'title': line.strip(), 'artist': ''})
print(songs_to_archive)

steps.code:
# Parse the note content to extract songs with TODO release dates
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
songs_todo = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Extract title, artists, and release info
        match = re.match(r'- (.+?) BY (.+?) RELEASED_AT (\S+)', line)
        if match:
            title = match.group(1)
            artists = match.group(2)
            release = match.group(3)
            if release == 'TODO':
                songs_todo.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'line': line})

print(f"Number of songs with TODO: {len(songs_todo)}")
for s in songs_todo:
    print(f"  {s['title']} BY {s['artists']}")

content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
new_lines = []

for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title from the line
        # Format: "- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        parts = line.split(' BY ')
        song_part = parts[0].lstrip('- ').strip()
        # The song title is everything before " BY "
        song_title = song_part
        
        # Get the release date for this song
        if song_title in release_dates:
            release_date = release_dates[song_title]
            new_line = line.replace('RELEASED_AT TODO', f'RELEASED_AT {release_date}')
            new_lines.append(new_line)
        else:
            # If no release date found, keep as is
            new_lines.append(line)
    else:
        new_lines.append(line)

new_content = '\n'.join(new_lines)
print(new_content)

for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Extract title and artists
        # Format: - Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2, ... RELEASED_AT TODO
        # We'll split on " BY " and then on " RELEASED_AT "
        if ' RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
            # Remove the prefix "- "
            line_content = line[2:]
            # Split on " BY " to get title and rest
            parts = line_content.split(' BY ')
            if len(parts) == 2:
                title = parts[0].strip()
                rest = parts[1]
                # rest contains artists and RELEASED_AT TODO
                # Split on " RELEASED_AT " to get artists
                artist_part = rest.split(' RELEASED_AT ')[0].strip()
                artists = [a.strip() for a in artist_part.split(',')]
                songs_to_process.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'line': line})
print(f"Found {len(songs_to_process)} songs to process")
for s in songs_to_process:

# Parse the note content to extract songs and identify those with TODO
import re

lines = note['content'].split('\n')
songs = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Extract title, artists, and release info
        # Format: - Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT MM/YYYY or TODO
        parts = line[2:].split(' BY ')
        title = parts[0].strip()
        rest = parts[1].strip()
        # Split at RELEASED_AT
        if ' RELEASED_AT ' in rest:
            artists_str, release_str = rest.split(' RELEASED_AT ')
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
            release = release_str.strip()
            songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'release': release, 'line': line})
        else:
            # malformed line, skip
            pass

# Print songs with TODO
for s in songs:
    if s['release'] == 'TODO':
        print(s['title'], '|', s['artists'], '|', s['release'])

# Parse the note content to extract songs and identify those with RELEASED_AT TODO
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
# Filter out the header line
song_lines = [line for line in lines if line.startswith('- ')]

songs = []
for line in song_lines:
    # Remove leading "- "
    line = line[2:]
    # Split on " BY " to get title and rest
    if ' BY ' in line:
        title_part, rest = line.split(' BY ', 1)
        # rest contains artists and RELEASED_AT
        # Split on " RELEASED_AT " to get artists and release info
        if ' RELEASED_AT ' in rest:
            artists_part, release_part = rest.split(' RELEASED_AT ', 1)
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
            release = release_part.strip()
        else:
            artists = [rest.strip()]
            release = None
    else:
        # No BY? skip
        continue
    songs.append({
        'title': title_part.strip(),
        'artists': artists,
        'release': release
    })

# Print songs with TODO
missing = [s for s in songs if s['release'] == 'TODO']
print(f"Total songs: {len(songs)}, missing: {len(missing)}")
for s in missing:
    print(s)

# Search for "Lost in the Embrace of Night"
result = apis.spotify.search_songs(query='Lost in the Embrace of Night', access_token=spotify_token, page_limit=20)
print(result)

# Parse the note content to extract songs with RELEASED_AT TODO
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs_todo = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title and artists
        # Format: - Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO
        # Remove leading "- "
        line_clean = line.strip()
        if line_clean.startswith('- '):
            line_clean = line_clean[2:]
        # Split on " BY " to get title and rest
        if ' BY ' in line_clean:
            title_part, rest = line_clean.split(' BY ', 1)
            # rest contains artists and RELEASED_AT TODO
            # Remove " RELEASED_AT TODO" from rest
            artists_part = rest.replace(' RELEASED_AT TODO', '').strip()
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
            songs_todo.append({'title': title_part.strip(), 'artists': artists, 'line': line_clean})
print("Songs with TODO:")
for s in songs_todo:
    print(s)

# Search for "Lost in the Embrace of Night"
result = apis.spotify.search_songs(query='Lost in the Embrace of Night', access_token=spotify_token, page_limit=20)
print(result)

# Parse the note content to extract songs with TODO release dates
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
# Skip the header line
song_lines = [line for line in lines if line.startswith('- ')]

# Extract song title, artists, and release info
songs_to_find = []
for line in song_lines:
    # Format: - Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO
    match = re.match(r'- (.+) BY (.+) RELEASED_AT (.+)', line)
    if match:
        title = match.group(1).strip()
        artists_str = match.group(2).strip()
        release_info = match.group(3).strip()
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
        if release_info == 'TODO':
            songs_to_find.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'line': line})
        else:
            print(f"Already has release: {title} - {release_info}")

print(f"\nSongs needing release info: {len(songs_to_find)}")
for s in songs_to_find:
    print(f"  - {s['title']} by {', '.join(s['artists'])}")

GOAL
I keep a log of all my liked songs and respective artists in a note in simple_note. I want to add release month information for them as well. I have added it for the first few songs. Add it for the rest.

PLAN (status: [x] done  [>] active  [ ] pending  [!] blocked  [-] invalidated)
[x] c1 Obtain the note 'Songs I have Liked' and its content
  [>] c2 Parse the note to extract all songs and identify those missing release month  -- Need to parse the note content to extract songs without RELEASED_AT.  needs: note
    [>] c3 For each song missing release month, search Spotify for its release date  -- Searched for a few songs; need to continue for all remaining songs.  needs: spotify_token
      [ ] c4 Update the note with release month for all songs  needs: access_token, simple_token, login_result, simple_note_token, spotify_token

CALL FORMS THAT WORKED (exact argument names; reuse them, do not re-login)
- supervisor.show_account_passwords()
- simple_note.login(username, password)
- simple_note.search_notes(access_token)
- simple_note.show_note(note_id, access_token)
- spotify.login(username, password)
- spotify.search_songs(query, access_token, page_limit)

CALL FORMS THAT FAILED (do not repeat as written)
- simple_note.search_notes() -> {"message":"You are either not authorized to access this simple_note API endpoint or your access token is missing, invalid or expired."}
- simple_note.login(email, password) -> {"message":"Validation error. Reason: \nusername: field required"}


LIVE VARIABLES: access_token, search_result, login_result, simple_note_token, simple_token, note, spotify_token, result

RESULTS ALREADY OBSERVED (printed, not stored in a variable; do not call again)
- supervisor.show_account_passwords() -> [ { "account_name": "amazon", "password": "U4ndtM1" }, { "account_name": "file_system", "p...
- spotify.login(password='!Y@Bv&B',username='ce-maldonado@gmail.com') -> { "access_token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJzcG90aWZ5K2NlLW1hbGRvbm...

FACTS
- The note 'Songs I have Liked' has note_id 3084 and contains lines like '- Song Title BY Artist RELEASED_AT MM/YYYY'.
- simple_note login requires 'username' parameter, not 'email' (s20 failed with bad_argument).
- simple_note access token expires; re-login needed (s19 failed with 401).
- Spotify search_songs returns release_date in ISO format (e.g., '2021-03-23T13:53:26').

NEXT
- c4 Update the note with release month for all songs (needs access_token, simple_token, login_result, simple_note_token, spotify_token)

GOAL
I keep a log of all my liked songs and respective artists in a note in simple_note. I want to add release month information for them as well. I have added it for the first few songs. Add it for the rest.

PLAN (status: [x] done  [>] active  [ ] pending  [!] blocked  [-] invalidated)
[>] c1 Retrieve and parse the full content of note 'Songs I have Liked' (note_id 3084) to identify all songs and which lack release month.  -- Current observations are truncated; need to fetch full content to parse all songs.  needs: simple_note_token
  [ ] c2 For each song missing release month, search Spotify to get its release date.  needs: spotify_token
    [ ] c3 Update the note content to include release month for all missing songs.  needs: simple_note_token, access_token, login_result, simple_token, spotify_token

CALL FORMS THAT WORKED (exact argument names; reuse them, do not re-login)
- supervisor.show_account_passwords()
- simple_note.login(username, password)
- simple_note.search_notes(access_token)
- simple_note.show_note(note_id, access_token)
- spotify.login(username, password)
- spotify.search_songs(query, access_token, page_limit)

CALL FORMS THAT FAILED (do not repeat as written)
- simple_note.search_notes() -> {"message":"You are either not authorized to access this simple_note API endpoint or your access token is missing, invalid or expired."}
- simple_note.login(email, password) -> {"message":"Validation error. Reason: \nusername: field required"}


LIVE VARIABLES: access_token, search_result, login_result, simple_note_token, simple_token, note, spotify_token, result

RESULTS ALREADY OBSERVED (printed, not stored in a variable; do not call again)
- supervisor.show_account_passwords() -> [ { "account_name": "amazon", "password": "U4ndtM1" }, { "account_name": "file_system", "p...

FACTS
- The note 'Songs I have Liked' has note_id 3084.
- Note content format: lines like '- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT MM/YYYY' for songs with release info.
- Some songs in the note already have RELEASED_AT, others do not.
- Spotify search_songs returns release_date in ISO format (e.g., '2021-03-23T13:53:26').
- simple_note update_note API exists and requires note_id, content, access_token.
- We have valid simple_note token (i20) and spotify token (i27) from recent logins.
- simple_note login requires 'username' parameter, not 'email'.
- simple_note tokens expire; need to re-login if 401.

# Parse the note content to extract songs that need release info
import re

content = note_content['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs_to_update = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Extract title and artists
        # Format: - Title BY Artist1, Artist2, ... RELEASED_AT TODO
        match = re.match(r'- (.+?) BY (.+?) RELEASED_AT (.+)', line)
        if match:
            title = match.group(1).strip()
            artists_str = match.group(2).strip()
            release_info = match.group(3).strip()
            if release_info == 'TODO':
                songs_to_update.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists_str, 'line': line})
print(f"Found {len(songs_to_update)} songs to update")
for s in songs_to_update:
    print(s)

# Search for "Lost in the Embrace of Night"
result = apis.spotify.search_songs(query='Lost in the Embrace of Night', access_token=spotify_token, page_limit=20)

# Parse the note content to extract songs and identify which need release info
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')

# Skip the header line
song_lines = [line for line in lines if line.startswith('- ')]

# Parse each line to extract title, artists, and release info
songs = []
for line in song_lines:
    # Remove leading "- "
    line = line[2:]
    # Check if it has RELEASED_AT
    if 'RELEASED_AT' in line:
        parts = line.split(' RELEASED_AT ')
        song_part = parts[0]
        release_part = parts[1]
        # Split song_part into title and artists
        # Format: "Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2"
        if ' BY ' in song_part:
            title, artists_str = song_part.split(' BY ', 1)
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
        else:
            title = song_part
            artists = []
        songs.append({
            'title': title.strip(),
            'artists': artists,
            'release': release_part.strip()
        })
    else:
        # No RELEASED_AT at all - but from the note, all have RELEASED_AT with either date or TODO
        # Just in case, treat as TODO
        if ' BY ' in line:
            title, artists_str = line.split(' BY ', 1)
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
        else:
            title = line
            artists = []
        songs.append({
            'title': title.strip(),
            'artists': artists,
            'release': 'TODO'
        })

# Print all songs and their release status
for s in songs:
    print(f"Title: {s['title']} | Artists: {s['artists']} | Release: {s['release']}")

I keep a log of all my liked songs and respective artists in a note in simple_note. I want to add release month information for them as well. I have added it for the first few songs. Add it for the rest.

[>] c3 Parse the note to extract all songs and identify which lack release month  -- Note content is truncated in observations; need full content to parse all songs  needs: note, access_token, login_result, simple_note_token, simple_token, spotify_token
[>] c4 For each song without release month, search Spotify for release date  -- Searched for some songs; need to cover all remaining songs  needs: spotify_token, access_token, login_result, simple_note_token, simple_token
[ ] c5 Update the note with release months for all songs  needs: note, access_token, login_result, simple_note_token, simple_token, spotify_token

CALL FORMS THAT WORKED (exact argument names; reuse them, do not re-login)
- supervisor.show_account_passwords()
- simple_note.login(username, password)
- simple_note.search_notes(access_token)
- simple_note.show_note(note_id, access_token)
- spotify.login(username, password)

CALL FORMS THAT FAILED (do not repeat as written)

LIVE VARIABLES: access_token, search_result, login_result, simple_note_token, simple_token, note, spotify_token, result

FACTS
- Note ID 3084 is the 'Songs I have Liked' note
- Note line format: '- Song Title BY Artist - RELEASED_AT MM/YYYY'
- Release month format is MM/YYYY
- simple_note token expired; re-login with correct parameter 'username'
- Spotify search_songs returns release_date field

NEXT

for line in song_lines:
    # Format: - Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT MM/YYYY or TODO
    # Use regex to extract title and artists
    match = re.match(r'- (.+?) BY (.+?) RELEASED_AT (.+)', line)
    if match:
        title = match.group(1)
        artists_str = match.group(2)

    else:

summary_used:
GOAL
I keep a log of all my liked songs and respective artists in a note in simple_note. I want to add release month information for them as well. I have added it for the first few songs. Add it for the rest.

CONSTRAINTS
- Release info format in the note is 'RELEASED_AT MM/YYYY' (e.g., 10/2022).

PLAN (status: [x] done  [>] active  [ ] pending  [!] blocked  [-] invalidated)
[>] c1 Parse the full content of note 3084 to extract all songs and identify which lack RELEASED_AT info.  -- Need to print the full note content to see all songs; current observation is truncated.  needs: note, access_token, login_result, simple_note_token, simple_token, spotify_token
[>] c2 For each song without release info, query Spotify search_songs to get its release date.  -- Some songs already searched; continue for remaining ones.  needs: spotify_token, note, access_token, login_result, simple_note_token, simple_token
[ ] c3 Update note 3084 with RELEASED_AT info for all songs that were missing it.  needs: simple_note_token, note, access_token, login_result, simple_token, spotify_token

CALL FORMS THAT WORKED (exact argument names; reuse them, do not re-login)
- supervisor.show_account_passwords()
- simple_note.login(username, password)
- simple_note.search_notes(access_token)
- simple_note.show_note(note_id, access_token)
- spotify.login(username, password)
- spotify.search_songs(query, access_token, page_limit)

CALL FORMS THAT FAILED (do not repeat as written)
- simple_note.search_notes() -> {"message":"You are either not authorized to access this simple_note API endpoint or your access token is missing, invalid or expired."}
- simple_note.login(email, password) -> {"message":"Validation error. Reason: \nusername: field required"}


LIVE VARIABLES: access_token, search_result, login_result, simple_note_token, simple_token, note, spotify_token, result

RESULTS ALREADY OBSERVED (printed, not stored in a variable; do not call again)
- supervisor.show_account_passwords() -> [ { "account_name": "amazon", "password": "U4ndtM1" }, { "account_name": "file_system", "p...
- spotify.login(password='!Y@Bv&B',username='ce-maldonado@gmail.com') -> { "access_token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJzcG90aWZ5K2NlLW1hbGRvbm...

FACTS
- The note 'Songs I have Liked' has note_id 3084.
- simple_note login requires 'username' parameter, not 'email' (bad_argument error).
- Spotify search_songs returns a 'release_date' field for each song.

NEXT
- c1 Parse the full content of note 3084 to extract all songs and identify which lack RELEASED_AT info. (needs note, access_token, login_result, simple_note_token, simple_token, spotify_token)
- c2 For each song without release info, query Spotify search_songs to get its release date. (needs spotify_token, note, access_token, login_result, simple_note_token, simple_token)
- c3 Update note 3084 with RELEASED_AT info for all songs that were missing it. (needs simple_note_token, note, access_token, login_result, simple_token, spotify_token)

import re

song_lines = [line for line in lines if line.startswith('- ')]

# Parse each line: format "- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
songs_todo = []
for line in song_lines:
    # Remove leading "- "
    line = line[2:]
    # Split on " RELEASED_AT "
    parts = line.split(' RELEASED_AT ')
    if len(parts) != 2:
        continue
    song_part, release_part = parts
    if release_part == 'TODO':
        # Split song_part on " BY "
        if ' BY ' in song_part:
            title, artists_str = song_part.split(' BY ', 1)
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
            songs_todo.append({'title': title.strip(), 'artists': artists, 'line': line})
        else:
            # No artists? skip
            pass

print("Songs with TODO:", len(songs_todo))
for s in songs_todo:
    print(s['title'], '|', s['artists'])

                    songs_to_update.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists})
                else:
                    print("No BY found in:", song_part)
            else:
                # Already has release info, skip
                pass

GOAL
I keep a log of all my liked songs and respective artists in a note in simple_note. I want to add release month information for them as well. I have added it for the first few songs. Add it for the rest.

PLAN (status: [x] done  [>] active  [ ] pending  [!] blocked  [-] invalidated)

[>] c2 Fetch release dates for all songs in the note that do not yet have RELEASED_AT, using Spotify search_songs.  -- Searched for several songs; need to continue for all remaining songs. Extract month/year from release_date.  needs: spotify_token, note, access_token, login_result, simple_note_token, simple_token
[ ] c3 Update the note (note_id 3084) via simple_note.update_note to add RELEASED_AT MM/YYYY for all songs that lack it.  needs: access_token, note, login_result, simple_note_token, simple_token, spotify_token

CALL FORMS THAT WORKED (exact argument names; reuse them, do not re-login)
- supervisor.show_account_passwords()
- simple_note.login(username, password)
- simple_note.search_notes(access_token)
- simple_note.show_note(note_id, access_token)
- spotify.login(username, password)
- spotify.search_songs(query, access_token, page_limit)

CALL FORMS THAT FAILED (do not repeat as written)
- simple_note.search_notes() -> {"message":"You are either not authorized to access this simple_note API endpoint or your access token is missing, invalid or expired."}
- simple_note.login(email, password) -> {"message":"Validation error. Reason: \nusername: field required"}


LIVE VARIABLES: access_token, search_result, login_result, simple_note_token, simple_token, note, spotify_token, result

RESULTS ALREADY OBSERVED (printed, not stored in a variable; do not call again)
- supervisor.show_account_passwords() -> [ { "account_name": "amazon", "password": "U4ndtM1" }, { "account_name": "file_system", "p...
- spotify.login(password='!Y@Bv&B',username='ce-maldonado@gmail.com') -> { "access_token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJzcG90aWZ5K2NlLW1hbGRvbm...

FACTS
- The note 'Songs I have Liked' has note_id 3084 and contains lines like '- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT MM/YYYY' for already updated songs.
- Spotify search_songs returns release_date in ISO format (e.g., '2021-03-23T13:53:26'); need to extract month/year as MM/YYYY.
- simple_note update_note API (PATCH /notes/{note_id}) is available and can update content.
- simple_note login requires parameter 'username' (not 'email'); using 'email' caused bad_argument error.
- simple_note API calls require access_token; missing it causes 401 errors.

# Parse the note content to extract songs that need release dates
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
# Skip the first line (title)
song_lines = [line for line in lines if line.startswith('- ')]

# Extract song title and artists for lines with RELEASED_AT TODO
songs_to_update = []
for line in song_lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Remove leading "- " and trailing " RELEASED_AT TODO"
        song_part = line[2:].replace(' RELEASED_AT TODO', '')
        # Split on " BY " to get title and artists
        if ' BY ' in song_part:
            title, artists_str = song_part.split(' BY ', 1)
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
            songs_to_update.append({'title': title.strip(), 'artists': artists, 'line': line})
        else:
            print(f"Could not parse line: {line}")

print(f"Found {len(songs_to_update)} songs to update")
for s in songs_to_update:
    print(s)

# Search for "Lost in the Embrace of Night"
result = apis.spotify.search_songs(query='Lost in the Embrace of Night', access_token=spotify_token, page_limit=20)
print(result)

summary_used:
GOAL
I keep a log of all my liked songs and respective artists in a note in simple_note. I want to add release month information for them as well. I have added it for the first few songs. Add it for the rest.

CONSTRAINTS
- Note content format: each song line is '- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2' optionally followed by 'RELEASED_AT MM/YYYY'.

PLAN (status: [x] done  [>] active  [ ] pending  [!] blocked  [-] invalidated)
[>] c1 Parse the note content to extract all songs and identify which already have release info.  -- Note content is truncated in observation; need to fetch full content or parse from the note object.  needs: note, access_token, login_result, simple_note_token, simple_token, spotify_token
[>] c2 For each song without release info, search Spotify to get release month.  -- Some songs already searched, but not all; need to search remaining songs.  needs: spotify_token, note, access_token, login_result, simple_note_token, simple_token
[ ] c3 Update the note with release month for each song.  needs: access_token, note, login_result, simple_note_token, simple_token, spotify_token

CALL FORMS THAT WORKED (exact argument names; reuse them, do not re-login)
- supervisor.show_account_passwords()
- simple_note.login(username, password)
- simple_note.search_notes(access_token)
- simple_note.show_note(note_id, access_token)
- spotify.login(username, password)
- spotify.search_songs(query, access_token, page_limit)

CALL FORMS THAT FAILED (do not repeat as written)
- simple_note.search_notes() -> {"message":"You are either not authorized to access this simple_note API endpoint or your access token is missing, invalid or expired."}
- simple_note.login(email, password) -> {"message":"Validation error. Reason: \nusername: field required"}


LIVE VARIABLES: access_token, search_result, login_result, simple_note_token, simple_token, note, spotify_token, result

RESULTS ALREADY OBSERVED (printed, not stored in a variable; do not call again)
- supervisor.show_account_passwords() -> [ { "account_name": "amazon", "password": "U4ndtM1" }, { "account_name": "file_system", "p...
- spotify.login(password='!Y@Bv&B',username='ce-maldonado@gmail.com') -> { "access_token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJzcG90aWZ5K2NlLW1hbGRvbm...

FACTS
- Note id 3084 is the 'Songs I have Liked' note.
- Simple_note login failed with wrong parameter name; correct parameter is 'username'.
- Spotify search_songs returns release_date field (e.g., '2021-03-23T13:53:26') which can be used to extract month/year.

NEXT
- c1 Parse the note content to extract all songs and identify which already have release info. (needs note, access_token, login_result, simple_note_token, simple_token, spotify_token)
- c2 For each song without release info, search Spotify to get release month. (needs spotify_token, note, access_token, login_result, simple_note_token, simple_token)
- c3 Update the note with release month for each song. (needs access_token, note, login_result, simple_note_token, simple_token, spotify_token)

    {"title": "On the Border of Reality", "artists": ["Lily Moon", "Zoey James"]},
    {"title": "A Love That Never Was", "artists": ["Mia Sullivan", "Carter Knight"]},
    {"title": "Astral Serenity", "artists": ["Orion Steele"]},
    {"title": "Between Reality and Reverie", "artists": ["Aria Sterling"]},
    {"title": "Strangers Again", "artists": ["Oceanic Odyssey"]},
    {"title": "The Mirage of a Perfect Life", "artists": ["Soulful Reverie"]},

    {"title": "When All Words Fail Us", "artists": ["Marcus Lane"]},
    {"title": "Final Echo", "artists": ["Hazel Winter"]},
]

# Search for each song and store release dates
release_dates = {}
for song in todo_songs:
    query = song["title"]
    result = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=query, access_token=spotify_token, page_limit=20)
    # Find the matching song
    found = None
    for item in result:
        if item["title"].lower() == song["title"].lower():
            # Check if artists match (at least one artist name matches)
            item_artists = [a["name"] for a in item["artists"]]
            if any(artist in item_artists for artist in song["artists"]):
                found = item
                break
    if found:
        release_date = found["release_date"]
        # Extract month/year
        month = release_date[5:7]
        year = release_date[0:4]
        release_dates[song["title"]] = f"{month}/{year}"
        print(f"Found: {song['title']} - {month}/{year}")
    else:
        print(f"NOT FOUND: {song['title']}")

print("\nAll release dates collected:")
for title, date in release_dates.items():
    print(f"{title}: {date}")

steps.code:
# Parse the note content to extract all songs and their release dates
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
songs = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Extract song title, artists, and release date
        match = re.match(r'- (.+?) BY (.+?)(?: RELEASED_AT (\d{2}/\d{4}))?$', line)
        if match:
            title = match.group(1)
            artists = match.group(2)
            release = match.group(3)
            songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'release': release, 'line': line})

print(f"Total songs in note: {len(songs)}")
for s in songs:
    print(f"  {s['title']} BY {s['artists']} -> RELEASED_AT: {s['release']}")

# Let's search for each song on Spotify to get its release date and compare with the note
# We'll iterate through all songs and search for each one
for song in songs:
    title = song['title']
    artists = song['artists']
    # Search with title and first artist to narrow down
    query = f"{title} {artists.split(',')[0].strip()}"
    result = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=query, access_token=spotify_token, page_limit=5)
    if result:
        # Find the exact match by checking title and artists
        found = None
        for item in result:
            if item['title'].lower() == title.lower():
                # Check if all artists in the note are in the item's artists
                note_artists = [a.strip() for a in artists.split(',')]
                item_artists = [a['name'] for a in item['artists']]
                if all(any(na.lower() == ia.lower() for ia in item_artists) for na in note_artists):
                    found = item
                    break
        if found:
            release_date = found['release_date']
            # Extract month and year
            from datetime import datetime
            dt = datetime.fromisoformat(release_date)
            month_year = f"{dt.month:02d}/{dt.year}"
            print(f"{title} BY {artists} -> Spotify: {month_year} | Note: {song['release']}")
        else:
            print(f"NOT FOUND: {title} BY {artists}")
    else:
        print(f"NO RESULT: {title} BY {artists}")

# Let's parse the note content to identify songs that need release dates.
content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs_to_fix = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- ') and 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song and artist
        # Format: - Song BY Artist RELEASED_AT TODO
        # Remove the leading "- " and trailing " RELEASED_AT TODO"
        line_clean = line[2:].replace(' RELEASED_AT TODO', '')
        # Split on " BY " to get song and artist(s)
        if ' BY ' in line_clean:
            song_title, artists_str = line_clean.split(' BY ', 1)
            # Take first artist (split by comma)
            first_artist = artists_str.split(',')[0].strip()
            songs_to_fix.append((song_title, first_artist, line))
        else:
            print(f"Could not parse line: {line}")
print(f"Found {len(songs_to_fix)} songs to fix")
for s in songs_to_fix:
    print(s)
